Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent sprite sheet for a simple layered PSD narrator portrait in a Japanese video project.
Primary request: Draw Zundamon (ずんだもん), the green edamame fairy character, as a beautifully drawn SD / super-deformed chibi anime mascot, approximately TWO HEADS TALL, huge round head and tiny compact body. This is original fan art of Zundamon, not a generic green-haired girl. Faithful recognizable green bob hairstyle with two edamame-shaped leaf tufts, warm amber-brown expressive eyes, cream-white short-sleeved blouse, green pinafore dress, tiny green shoes. Cute, friendly, professional Japanese chibi illustration, confident dark green linework, refined cel shading, subtle warm highlights, clean edges, lovely expressive eyes. Not a geometric diagram, not flat SVG-looking clipart.
Composition: one exact 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet on a 2048 by 1536 transparent canvas, six equal-size rectangular cells. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete full-body Zundamon, same character design, same scale, same centered front-facing neutral standing pose, same head and feet positions, arms gently down slightly away from body. Each character including hair tufts and shoes fully fits within its cell with clear transparent margins; no overlaps between cells. Body and hair pose must stay consistent, only face changes. Row 1 left to right: normal gentle closed-mouth smile with open eyes; happy smile with eyes closed into arcs and a small cheerful open mouth; playful wink with a tiny open smile. Row 2 left to right: surprised wide eyes and small O mouth; slightly worried eyebrows and small closed mouth; smug half-lidded eyes and small confident closed smile. Very subtle blush on all faces.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background; NO checkerboard pattern, NO backdrop, NO ground, NO drop shadow, NO borders or grid lines, NO text or labels, NO watermark, NO props, NO additional characters. Only the six consistent SD Zundamon sprites arranged neatly in the specified grid. Emphasize excellent drawing quality and true two-head-tall super-deformed proportions.
edit: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this transparent 3-by-2 Zundamon SD expression sprite sheet. Keep the exact same six beautifully drawn characters, their two-head-tall SD proportions, all face expressions, colors, linework, clothes, and front-facing pose. Only correct the layout and padding: each of the 6 sprites must be about 15% smaller within its own equal-sized grid cell, centered horizontally, with a generous clean transparent margin on ALL FOUR SIDES. Reconstruct any tiny clipped leaf tip at the top so every character is fully complete. Keep the grid 3 columns x 2 rows. Use a 2048x1536 canvas. Row 1 normal, happy, wink; row 2 surprised, worried, smug, in exactly the current order. True transparent alpha background, absolutely no text, grid lines, border, ground, shadow, watermark, or checkerboard. Nothing may touch a canvas edge or adjacent cell. Preserve the existing illustration rather than redesigning it.
